caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall, ornate vase or goblet-like object centered on a plain beige background. The object is predominantly deep blue in color, with lighter blue and white highlights suggesting a glossy, glass-like surface. Its structure consists of a broad, undulating rim at the top, tapering inward before expanding outward in a series of faceted, geometric panels along the body. The middle section features a series of rounded, raised oval designs set within rectangular frames. Below this, the object narrows into a rounded, knob-like stem, then flares out again into a broad, sturdy base with defined contours and angular sections. At the bottom left of the drawing, there is a faint horizontal measuring scale, and the name "John Dana" appears lightly inscribed in the lower right corner. The composition presents the object in isolation with no additional elements or background details.
title: Vase
